items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Ron Carter in the context of a Lionel Hampton event, but Dave Brubeck does not respond or provide any personal connection.

ctx.x: There was a [Jimmy] Carter event. Were you at the Carter jazz . . .?
Yeah, in the Rose Garden, Carter.
That’s the night I played with Lionel [Hampton], wasn’t it? Lionel had told us what he’s going to play. He didn’t play one thing that he told us. That great bass player . . .

items.title: Ron Carter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met all those guys because I was … 'Hey man, what you doing up here?' ... This particular show had Lambert, Hendricks & Ross and their band, Dave Brubeck, Miles Davis and Chico Hamilton.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was honest, he was blunt, you know. While it wasn't a new feeling to have .. to hear this, it was kind of a drag because you'd put all this time in in this industry, call it orchestra playing, and to hear that one of the items on the hiring peoples' list is what race you are, it just seems to be what a waste of effort and energy on their part. It seems to me that music sounds great when great players play them. Whatever color they are. But when you are eighteen, you don't think that philosophically; you…
